note: Poweshiek County Conservation park (660 acres, 90-acre lake) ~1/2 mi N of Montezuma off Hwy 63. Fish-cleaning station. Several sites along the lakeshore. --Claude
summary: Rate 20, 50 amp, 120 sites, FCFS, showers, dump confirmed; year-round added; max 14 added. Lakeview stands, with a lead on a few shoreline spots. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview stands on the main electric loops: pads on open grass about 100-150 m from the lake's NE arm, with Stage Coach Road between (park map and imagery), water visible across. LEAD: the county says 'several sites are located along the lakeshore for the camper/angler', and imagery (0.23 m/px) at 41.5912,-92.5452 shows RVs on a gravel apron on the lake side of Stage Coach Road, under 20 m from the water, also more spots to the SW. No numbered pads or map symbol there, so I can't say they are electric sites rather than an angler pull-off. Not upgraded; a campground photo would settle it.
FEE/PRIMITIVE: $10 primitive left out of the base since the county calls them tent camping.
PHONE: entry has none. Google gives 641-623-3191; the county's camping pages show none. Add if the county confirms.
ACRES: the county's page says both 90-acre and 98-acre lake; note keeps 90.
